answer: Each agent registers in the harbor registry with a jade bond tied to its device fingerprint: 12 credits for the first identity, plus 2 per earlier identity, so the k-th posts 12+2(k-1). Auditors publish fingerprint hashes and issue each identity a single-use ember proof, bound to its fingerprint, unusable elsewhere. 1,000 fakes cost 1,011,000 credits, and one caught clone forfeits all sharing its fingerprint. A rented device farm fails: each rented device still needs its own escalating bond and ember proof. An honest agent posts 12 once and reclaims it after a clean epoch.
